Applied to the OpenVPN config as “dhcp-option DNS”. The VPN server may push its own DNS and override these values — SP VPN has no separate DNS API in the BongoVPN library.
DNS settings saved. They apply to the next connection.
Please enter a valid DNS address (e.g. 8.8.8.8).
SP VPN shows a foreground notification with live speed while connected. Notification permission is requested on first launch.
Built on BongoVPN 1.0.3 (Apache 2.0, Copyright 2026 Bongo Tech) and ics-openvpn. A real OpenVPN client — SP VPN is not a simulator.

SP VPN ships no VPN server of its own. The only bundled endpoint is the public VPNGate relay (public-vpn-187.opengw.net:443) from the upstream sample. It is a third-party public relay that may be offline, slow, or rotated at any time. If it fails, import your own working .ovpn file from your own VPN provider or server. The app shows the real connection error instead of pretending to connect.
